title: He Does This After Girl Refuses to Talk to Him
description:
► USCCA
https://www.uscca.com/codeblue 

On June 13, 2022, Kenosha County Sheriff’s deputies responded to a store after dispatch advised an armed male was threatening an employee in Somers, WI. Upon arrival, deputies convinced him to put down the weapon and he was quickly taken into custody. It was soon discovered the weapon was fake. His main goal was to confront a female employee who had a restraining order against him. 

► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
